additional_info.subject: ID0369323-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117035] Charging process doesn't start CRM:00315001597
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Emre-abi,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R6 313065117035
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
GIJf5Q
Problem Description
: Charging process doesn't start. Authentication failed.
Troubleshooting
:
Here are my findings:
From this photo below, you can see all the RemoteStartTransaction commands, but not all of them result in a successfull session. The ones with a Square are the ones that don't pass through.
For the Session at 13/7- 10:08, the user started the session remotely and took 3 minutes to start the session.
For the Session at 08:09:
Transaction was only provided almost 10mins later.
For the Session at 05:17 there was just a RemoteStartTransaction but no plug in.
From these sessions only 6 go through, as you stated:
Almost all the session are because the Authentication is failed. Either because they don't provide it, take too long, or something wrong with the backend not sending the StartTransaction.
Let me know your thoughts.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0369323
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0369323-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117035] Charging process doesn't start CRM:00315001597
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
Thank you so much for analyze.
This customer currently has over 160 devices online. I don't think it's normal to have so many authentication errors. Something must be wrong.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0369323-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117035] Charging process doesn't start CRM:00315001597
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
When I examined the SECC errors of this device, I saw error code: 54 for 40 times and error code: 67 for 3 times in the last week.
Do you think this is critical?

additional_info.subject: ID0369323-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117035] Charging process doesn't start CRM:00315001597
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi, good morning.
For the Error 54 it's due to the Authentication being failed:
For the Error 67 I would need you to confirm to me if it's a Mercedes eActross eTruck, otherwise, this error usually relates to a EV error where it sends a B state while Charging (C state).
Thank you very much, I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0369323-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117035] Charging process doesn't start CRM:00315001597
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
There is something wrong with this charger. I will go to the site on Thursday to examine this.

additional_info.subject: ID0369323-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117035] Charging process doesn't start CRM:00315001597
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi,
Thank you for sharing your concerns, Furkan shared this with me some time ago. The sessions are not started because the Authentication is not provided, there are some sessions where this works, so I think this is related to the OCPP backend.
My recommendation would be to align with the backend and have a call with them while you test it on site. I haven't completely checked this but if the signal is bad, perhaps the message doesn't reach the server.
Best regards,
Francisco
